brief: #150 gave the distance four ranks and the band above the roofline stopped being a cut-out. It left c238, two claims I am passing on UNVERIFIED: (1) the ranks occupy only about 5 cellH above the horizon while topPad reserves 9.6, so over half the sky strip above hz is still empty gradient; (2) the ranks cross the near town's ridge at the right edge, where it dips to 0.70 cellH above hz — the far town showing through where our own should occlude it. The arithmetic I can see from the source is topPad = 4 + 9.6*cellH (plus spare) and hz = topPad - 3.4*cellH, and FAR_BANDS[0].t1 = -3.40, so the furthest rank's TALLEST possible top reaches exactly the top of the world area. Whether the DRAWN tops get anywhere near it is the measurement. Re-price both claims on HEAD before you build anything; fix whichever reproduces, and if neither does, the refutation plus the corrected source comment is the shipped work.
successLooksLike: From the wide shot the band above the roofline reads as distance with something in it at every framing and size, and no far rank appears where our own town should stand in front of it. Measured against a same-code control, and the strip's occupied fraction quoted before and after.
avoid: The backdrop is ONE cached layer keyed on backKey — a per-frame truth on it is a live overlay, not a cache edit, and a warm pixel painted INTO the cache arrives slate after applyLight's multiply (that is exactly how #150 found HEAD's 80 'lit dots' were never lights). No new R(): this is the renderer, so hash() only. Sky x Polish is marked SATURATED since #32 — this is Deepen, and it must change what is THERE, not retint it.
